Inspect actual compute provenance

Source: R/cell-workflow.R
cuda_provenance.Rd

This is the shared cudatensr::cuda_provenance() inspector, re-exposed for single-cell results.

Usage

cuda_provenance(x)

Arguments

x

A cudaverse result or named list of compute stages.

Value

A cuda_provenance data frame.
